subject: Closure: prompt-output & kernel logs purge — next steps
messages:
From: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@novamed.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: IT Security <security@novamed.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Request: confirm deletion workflow for prompt outputs and kernel logs

Hi Connor,

We need a written confirmation and timeline from Redwood for the purge of all prompt inputs/outputs, transient kernel logs and any cached KV artifacts related to our test namespace (namespace: novamed-prod-sbx). This is to close an incident in our compliance tracker — we require:

- exact scope (models, buckets, logs)
- who will run the purge and when
- how you’ll generate proof-of-deletion (checksums, manifests, signed evidence)
- expected retention of audit logs and where they will be hosted

Can you respond with the runbook and a target completion window? We prefer a single-turn closure (same day) if feasible.

Thanks,
Audrey
Audrey Chen
Head of Trust & Security, NovaMed

Audrey: attaching the compliance ticket ID: NOVA-2026-4412

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: confirm deletion workflow for prompt outputs and kernel logs

Hi Audrey — thanks for the clear list. High level answer up front: we will perform a targeted expunction of the namespace artifacts, purge related kernel trace logs, and produce a signed manifest and tarball of zero-byte placeholders as proof. Target window: today (7/15) with completion by EOD PST.

Outline below; I’ll loop in Ops for exact runbook and evidence links.

Scope:
- prompt inputs/outputs: S3 prefix s3://redwood-prod/prompt-outputs/novamed-prod-sbx/*
- KV cache snapshots: kvstore/novamed-prod-sbx/* (TTL override to immediate purge)
- runtime/kernel logs: GPU host logs filtered by namespace tag 'novamed-prod-sbx'

Immediate plan:
1) Ops will set a one-shot job to mark items for deletion and sweep the KV store.
2) We’ll run a kernel-log scrub to remove traces older than 0s for the namespace and rotate any host-level logs to a sealed archive.
3) Generate a cryptographic manifest (SHA256 list) of removed object names and sizes; create a TAR containing a manifest + signed statement.

Evidence and retention:
- Evidence tarball + manifest uploaded to Redwood Shared Drive and link provided to you (read-only).
- Audit trail preserved in our compliance retention (immutable) for 90 days, then moved to cold archive for 365 days (indexed).

Marissa / Neha — can you confirm ETA for the run and the attachments I should expect for proof?

Connor
Director, Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@novamed.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: confirm deletion workflow for prompt outputs and kernel logs

Hi all — ops runbook and checklist attached (redwood_purge_runbook_v2.pdf). Short summary:

- Prep (10m): snapshot current indices; ensure no in-flight jobs reference the namespace.
- Sweep (30m): run object-store purge job with immediate consistency path (deletes + tombstone compaction).
- KV purge (10m): TTL override + compaction on the memstore nodes for namespace key ranges.
- Kernel log scrub (20m): filter by tag and zero out ephemeral traces; rotate host-logs into sealed archive.
- Verification (15m): run manifest generator, sign with platform key, upload evidence.

We’ll run at 13:00 PDT and expect completion by 14:30 PDT. Attachments you will get: ops-checklist-20260715.xlsx, sweep-evidence-20260715.tar.gz (signed), redwood_purge_runbook_v2.pdf.

Notes: the sweep will produce zero-byte placeholder objects for provenance; we will not deliver original content. The signed manifest includes SHA256s of the removed object keys (size should be zero).

-Neha will retain the audit log bundle under the compliance retention policy.

Marissa
Principal, Platform Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@novamed.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: confirm deletion workflow for prompt outputs and kernel logs

Thanks — appreciate the level of detail. A few quick clarifications before you run:

1) For the manifest SHA256s: will you include object key paths and an HMAC using Redwood's platform signing key so we can verify integrity?
2) Where will the evidence be stored (URL) and can it be restricted to our security group only?
3) If anything unexpected is found (e.g., larger-than-expected artifacts), please pause and escalate to me immediately.

If the HMAC and access controls are possible, we’re OK to proceed with the 13:00 PDT start.

-Audrey
